title: Wayi Hussain E Maan Noor E Do Aaina E Maan
body:
Wayi Hussain E Maan Noor E Do Aaina E Maan
Waye Ghareeb E Maan Aayi Waye Shaheed E Maan
1. Wati Ghareebi Ke Lab E Tashna Buri Dand Saarat
Nala San Souqt Ze Dagh E Ali Akber Jigarat
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Naala E Tashna Laban Roba Barein Baad E Saba
Be Souye Turbat E Zehra Dami Az Rahe Wafa
